description: Zoom REST API connector (read-only). Surfaces the authenticated user's scheduled meetings as `zoom:meeting` items AND cloud-recording transcripts as `zoom:transcript` items (prose-heavy embedding) in the local index via `GET /v2/users/me/meetings?type=scheduled` and `GET /v2/users/me/recordings`. Bearer OAuth auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`; short-lived access token refreshed by the Gateway via the 3-legged OAuth flow; never logged); fixed SaaS host api.zoom.us; transcript `download_url` fetches use the Bearer header — the token never appears in a logged URL. The recordings walk windowing keeps each request inside Zoom's ≤1-month constraint, and a skip-if-exists check on `<meeting_uuid>:<recording_file_id>` avoids re-downloading immutable transcripts.
author: Nimbus
